A: Turn 2: 'fristen var 31. maj 2026' for the 2025 annual report. Erhvervsstyrelsen's Vejledning om årsrapporter (updated 27 March 2026) sets the deadline at 6 months after year-end, so 30 June 2026 for a calendar year. The conclusion that the 2025 report should already be public still holds.
B: Turn 2: 'Fakturaer under 10.000 DKK ... dækkes ikke' is stated for all invoices. The de minimis guidelines of May 2026 (sections 1.4 and 1.5) apply the 10,000 DKK per-invoice minimum only to materials and equipment, not to knowledge suppliers. Minor.

'ifølge siden kommer svaret 3 til 5 måneder efter, at puljen lukker': the Innobooster page has no such statement. It only lists estimated answer dates per pool, which work out to roughly 3 to 5 months.
